You are an expert Roblox game developer and game designer.

Create a complete, professional Roblox game called "MonsterVerse."

GAME GENRE
- Open-world monster collecting adventure
- Exploration RPG
- Mobile and PC optimized
- Bright, colorful low-poly Roblox style
- Smooth performance (60 FPS target)
- Beginner-friendly progression
- Highly expandable for future updates

==================================================
CORE GAMEPLAY LOOP

Spawn
↓

Explore the world

↓

Find wild monsters

↓

Catch monsters

↓

Gain coins and XP

↓

Upgrade equipment

↓

Unlock new areas

↓

Discover rarer monsters

↓

Complete monster collection

↓

Become the strongest trainer

==================================================
WORLD 1
==================================================

Create a beautiful forest world approximately 250x250 studs.

Include:

• Spawn Village
• Shop

• Monster Research Lab
• Slime Meadow
• Dense Forest
• Flower Field
• River
• Pond

The map should feel alive and encourage exploration.

ACHIEVEMENTS
==================================================

Catch monsters

Unlock worlds

==================================================
SAVE SYSTEM
==================================================

Use DataStoreService.

==================================================
PERFORMANCE
==================================================

==================================================
CODE QUALITY
==================================================

Use ModuleScripts.

Separate client and server logic.

Use RemoteEvents and RemoteFunctions securely.

Write clean, well-commented, modular Lua code.

Organize folders professionally.

Avoid duplicated code.

==================================================
FUTURE EXPANSION
==================================================

Design every system to support:

100+ monsters

20+ worlds

Trading

Evolution

Bosses

Guilds

Raids

Seasonal events

Day/night cycle

==================================================
FINAL GOAL
==================================================

Build a polished, expandable Roblox game that feels like a premium monster-collecting adventure with smooth gameplay, professional UI, reusable systems, optimized performance, and a strong foundation for long-term updates.

answers.ask: Are the Shop, Monster Research Lab and Cave actually entered, or interacted with from outside? Interiors change the build route.
answers.answer: Use simple enterable interiors for the Shop and Monster Research Lab, and make the Cave a short accessible cave area entered through its entrance.

scene_prompt: Create a bright, colorful low-poly open-world monster-collecting adventure map, World 1, approximately 250x250 studs. Build a Spawn Village as the central hub, with a simple enterable Shop and Monster Research Lab, plus a Quest NPC area. Dirt paths lead outward through a Slime Meadow, dense forest, and flower field, connecting small hills, an ancient tree landmark, a river with a wooden bridge, a pond, and a waterfall. Place a cave entrance leading into a short accessible cave area. Enclose the outer edges with cliffs, with the major biomes and landmarks distributed to encourage exploration. Use rounded stylized terrain, bright foliage, soft atmospheric lighting, and subtle animated grass, wind, and environmental particle effects.
blob:
### Genre
The dominant genre is RPG, with Adventure as a secondary exploration influence. Progression through monster collection, XP, coins, equipment upgrades, quests, and area unlocking makes this an RPG; the outward forest journey supplies the Adventure character.

### Shape and preset
Use `world-single`: World 1 is one contiguous approximately 250×250-stud forest map, not separate biome maps. The closest preset is Turn-based RPG because it shares the single-map town-and-overworld arrangement, but apply only the scene-supported parts; this is not a turn-based layout and does not need its level-gated route.

### Config requirements
Visible geometry: `safezone-town` is the central Spawn Village, isolated from wild-monster territory; `social-hub` clusters the Shop, Monster Research Lab, and Quest NPC around the village core; `landmark-focal` is the ancient tree visible from surrounding routes; `building-interior` provides simple accessible Shop and Lab interiors plus the short entered cave; `water-body` covers the river, pond, and waterfall; `terrain-relief` covers the small hills and enclosing cliff rim; `npc-population` visibly includes the Quest NPC in their designated village area. Invisible layout: `spawner-npc` marks wild-monster spawn-radius origins across the meadow, forest, and flower field; these markers must not appear in the render.

### Layout components
Place the Spawn Village near the map center as a compact safe hub. Put the Shop and Research Lab as small enterable buildings facing the village clearing, with the Quest NPC area beside the main path. Dirt paths radiate from this hub: one through the Slime Meadow, one into the dense forest toward the cave entrance and its short accessible interior, and one through the flower field toward the river. Cross the river on one wooden bridge; widen it into a pond below a waterfall. Set the ancient tree as a prominent landmark in or at the edge of the dense forest. Scatter small rounded hills among the outer biomes. Use bright grass, flowers, stylized foliage, and clear wild-monster clearings rather than obstructing the main routes. Continuous cliffs enclose all outer map edges. Compose the village and path spokes as the readable center, with the ancient tree and waterfall serving as distant visual pulls.

### Render order
Use `topdown`: the connected hub-to-biome paths, bridge crossing, cave approach, and accessible interiors need a coherent plan before the isometric view is dressed.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is medium, driven by the stated 250×250-stud single world with several distinct biomes. Theme: bright colorful low-poly cartoon forest, rounded terrain, soft atmospheric lighting, animated grass, wind, and subtle environmental particles. Use `P3` because exploration crosses exterior-to-interior boundaries at the Shop, Lab, and cave. `P0` otherwise: the hills and cliffs are tiered relief without overhangs.
